# Invoiceza

> Free online invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses. Create, customize, and download professional PDF invoices instantly — no signup required.

Invoiceza is a browser-based invoicing tool built with Next.js. All user data is processed locally in the browser; nothing is sent to servers. The app is 100% free with no watermarks, no account needed, and no hidden fees.

## Primary Tools

- [Free Invoice Generator](https://invoiceza.com/): Create and download professional PDF invoices in seconds. Supports multiple currencies, tax/discount calculations, logo upload, and auto-save drafts.
- [Receipt Maker](https://invoiceza.com/receipt-maker): Generate and download professional PDF receipts for goods and services.
- [Quotation Maker](https://invoiceza.com/quotation-maker): Create formal price quotations with fixed pricing, validity dates, and payment terms.
- [Estimate Maker](https://invoiceza.com/estimate-maker): Build cost estimates with itemized labor and materials, contingency percentages, and disclaimers.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- **Cost**: 100% free. No subscriptions, no premium tiers, no watermarks.
- **Account required**: No. Works immediately without any signup.
- **Data storage**: All data stays in the user's browser (localStorage). Nothing is uploaded to servers.
- **PDF output**: Instant client-side PDF generation using @react-pdf/renderer.
- **Currencies supported**: 30+ currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, INR, JPY, CAD, AUD.
- **Tax support**: GST (India), VAT (UK/EU), Sales Tax (US). Smart presets auto-configure rates.
- **Keyboard shortcuts**: Ctrl+S (save draft), Ctrl+D (download PDF), Ctrl+N (new invoice), Ctrl+L (add line item).
- **Auto-save**: Drafts auto-saved every 30 seconds.
- **Contact email**: support@invoiceza.com
